hero.title: Code with AI that never leaves your computer.
hero.lead: Chat, inline edits and a team of coding agents, powered only by models running on your own computer. No account, no cloud, no subscription.
hero.meta: Version {{version}} for Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, {{size}} MB. Open source under Apache-2.0.

showcase.alt: The Ylide editor with the file tree, a JavaScript file and the chat panel
showcase.caption: Files, editor and chat in one window. Everything runs on your computer.

chat.title: Ask your project.
chat.body: Attach files, folders or symbols with @. Models that understand images also see the screenshots and photos you paste or drop, in the chat and in the agents. The answer streams word by word from the model on your graphics card, and what you ask stays here.
chat.question: What does applyDiscount in @cart.js do?
chat.answer: It takes a percentage off every item and rounds to whole cents. Values below 0 or above 100 are rejected with a TypeError.
chat.stats: 75 tokens per second, on this computer

inline.title: Change code where it is.
inline.body: Select, press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd>, describe what should be different. Ylide shows the change as a diff, and you accept or discard it.

agents.title: A team that hands work back and forth.
agents.body: The orchestrator plans, the coder writes, the reviewer checks. Every hand-off is a crossing of their world lines. Commands and deletions run only after you approve them, and every step can be undone with checkpoints.
agents.step1: The orchestrator reads the project and splits the request into three tasks.
agents.step2: The coder changes cart.js and runs the tests.
agents.step3: The reviewer checks the diff and asks for a test for empty carts.
agents.step4: The coder adds the test. Twelve of twelve tests pass.
agents.step5: The reviewer approves the task. You see every change before it stays.

skills.title: Teach your models how you work.
skills.body: Skills are instructions in the open Agent Skills format: a SKILL.md and optional reference files. Add them from a GitHub repository or a folder, and every model can use them, in the chat and in the agents. New skills start switched off, and Ylide shows you each one before you switch it on.
skills.writeTests: Writes tests in the style of this project.
skills.releaseNotes: Drafts release notes from the git log.
skills.apiReview: Checks changed endpoints for breaking changes.

hardware.title: Made to fit your hardware.
hardware.body: On first start, Ylide measures your graphics card, memory and processor and suggests the strongest model that runs smoothly on them. Then it downloads the model, checks the file and starts it.

privacy.title: Five doors to the outside. All of them yours.
privacy.body: Ylide collects no usage data, has no sign-in and never uploads your code. It goes online for these five purposes only. Each one can be switched off, skill downloads stay off until you allow them, and every request appears in the network log.

open.title: Open down to the last line.
open.body: Ylide is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. The source code of every release is on GitHub, so you can read it, build it yourself and help develop it.
open.smartscreen: Windows may warn you on the first start because the installer is not commercially signed yet. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: In short: this website sets no cookies, uses no analytics and loads nothing from other servers. Ylide itself sends your code and your prompts nowhere.
privacyPage.website: The website runs on a server of Hetzner Online GmbH in Germany. To deliver the pages, the server processes your IP address and the details your browser sends along. It does not store them: there is no access log. Fonts, images and scripts all come from ylide.app.
privacyPage.app: Ylide connects to the internet for five purposes only, each one switchable in the settings: updating the model list (ylide.app), downloading models (huggingface.co), downloading runtimes (github.com), checking for updates (ylide.app) and downloading skills (api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com), which stays off until you allow it. When it updates the model list or checks for updates, our server learns your IP address and the version number of Ylide. Neither is stored. Downloads from GitHub and huggingface.co are covered by their privacy policies.
privacyPage.rights: You have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict the processing of your data, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority. Since we store no personal data, there is usually nothing to report. Feel free to write to us anyway.
